name: Naria
source:
A bird-type human robot, always dreaming about spreading his wings and flying in the blue sky. Even after withstanding all the rigorous discipline the doctor (you) put him through, will his dream come true? Only the doctor knows...

[From [url=https://www.rainbow-shoppers.com/en/www/cdrom_abdiel.html]Rainbow Shoppers[/url]]
